whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Momo Magic Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.9★ reviews in Kidwaipuri, Patna, but currently relies on a third-party aggregator page instead of a dedicated branded website for direct table bookings and takeaway orders.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table reservations, aur special combos integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/momomagic

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Momo Magic Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (Momo Magic Cafe in Kidwaipuri, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your 4.9-star review highlights so local customers can order straight from your mobile page without third-party commissions. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
